description: This Java source file defines the ImageHandler class, a component in the OpenMRS system responsible for handling the storage and retrieval of image data associated with complex observations. It supports reading image files, determining MIME types, saving image data to the file system, and integrating with the OpenMRS data model.

classes.name: ImageHandler
classes.description: A Spring component class that manages the handling of image data for complex observations, supporting reading, saving, and MIME type management.

methods.name: ImageHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set of supported image formats based on available ImageIO writers.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves the image data associated with a complex Obs object, supporting the RAW view by reading image bytes and setting MIME type.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the list of supported views, which includes only the RAW view.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves the image data from an Obs object into the file system, generating a filename, storing data, and updating the Obs object with the new reference.
